_comment: Core library, rest and carry (G4; HEROES_V2.md 4.4: the base controller plays them). Sit and sleep are on the ground, the seat and back placed by the form-scaled floor fix, so they fit every form.

rest.sit.description: Sitting on the ground at rest, 8 s loop: the right leg out, the left knee up with the forearm on it, the right hand on the thigh; slow breathing, glances, an ear twitch now and then, a lazy tail sway.

rest.sleep.description: Asleep on the back, 8 s loop (the entity stands at the hips, the body lies behind it): slow deep breathing (4 s), sleeping eyes through face_ctrl, an ear twitch, a small shift of the head at 5 s.

carry.loop.description: Hauling a full load, 1.0 s walk in place (HaulerJob): a shorter, heavier stride with more side-to-side tip, leaning back a little, forearms forward under the load (A2 draws the item at item_r), the load bobbing with each step.
